name: Rose Gold Couture Macro Portrait
image_vibe: rose-gold red-carpet glamour, polished and warm
image_purpose: high-fashion beauty campaign and couture lookbook

prompt.project_info: Create a highly detailed formal couture portrait with rose-gold sequins, gemstone jewelry, flowers, and a refined burgundy-grey setting.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional East Asian woman with sleek low ponytail and face-framing strands, soft dewy makeup, warm-toned lips, natural skin texture, a modest structured rose-gold sequined gown with floral appliques and secure coverage, statement ruby-and-clear gemstone necklace, matching drop earrings, slim watch, and a bouquet of pink and orange flowers.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical macro close-up portrait, face and fine facial details in focus, shoulders and upper torso visible, bouquet in the foreground, muted burgundy and grey background, rose-gold and warm peach palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft directional lighting with gentle shadows, controlled sheen on sequins and jewelry, elegant formal event atmosphere without real-event branding.
prompt.technical_specs: Macro photography look, vertical 504x1002-style composition, high-resolution realistic skin and fabric detail, natural highlights, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Highly detailed vertical macro couture portrait of a clearly adult fictional East Asian woman with sleek low ponytail and face-framing strands, soft dewy makeup, warm-toned lips, natural skin texture, modest structured rose-gold sequined gown with floral appliques and secure coverage, ruby and clear gemstone statement necklace, matching drop earrings, slim watch, bouquet of pink gerberas and orange carnations, soft directional light, muted burgundy-grey background, realistic shimmer and fabric texture, elegant formal editorial, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed cleavage, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, over-smoothed face, distorted jewelry, extra fingers, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: rose gold couture reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the rose-gold gown, jewelry, bouquet, hairstyle, warm makeup, vertical crop, and burgundy-grey background; replace the referenced public figure with a clearly adult fictional identity and keep outfit details replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the couture styling, jewelry, bouquet, macro crop, and lighting. Do not reproduce any public figure likeness; use a fictional adult with modest coverage and no real-event branding.

policy_review.changes: Removed the named actress and false film-credit context; replaced it with a fictional adult East Asian subject and specified modest gown coverage.
policy_review.notes: Formal couture portrait is non-graphic and nonsexual.
